name: Kimi Code CLI
description: Open-source terminal-based AI coding agent from Moonshot AI, released June 6, 2026. MIT-licensed tool written entirely in TypeScript, migrating from the previous Python-based kimi-cli. Features subagent support, multi-agent collaboration, and 256K context window for software development tasks and terminal operations.
community_quotes: Migrated from Python to TypeScript for better performance
Part of Moonshot AI's next-gen agent initiative

name: Claude Fable 5
description: Anthropic's latest model release in the Claude 5 family, launching June 9, 2026. A restricted version of the Mythos 5 model, integrated into Claude Code and GitHub Copilot for enhanced AI coding capabilities with improved safety classifiers.
community_quotes: Launched in Claude Code and GitHub Copilot

name: GitHub Code Quality
description: AI-assisted code quality and security tool announced June 16, 2026, with general availability on July 20, 2026. Provides automated code review, vulnerability detection with CodeQL, and Copilot Autofix for automatic vulnerability remediation. Priced at $10 per active committer per month plus usage-based costs.
community_quotes: Copilot Autofix works without separate Copilot subscription
Community concerns about pricing changes and usage-based billing
